sentences.text: The accused was charge-sheeted and charges was framed on 01.10.2024 against the accused for the offence U/s 498A/304B IPC, to which the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed trial.
RAJINDER KUMAR PROSECUTION EVIDENCE 4.

In order to prove the charges, the prosecution examined 5 witness as under:-
(i) Sh. Abdul Razak (PW-1) deposed that deceased Shaheen was his niece, who was married to accused Nasruddin Ansari; that he had never heard about any maltreatment or cruelty committed by accused upon his niece; that the deceased was living happily with the accused and that his deceased niece was having an adamant nature.
FIR no. 583/2023 State Vs. Nasruddin Ansari (ii) Ms. Ajibun Bano (PW-2) deposed that her daughter Shaheen got married with accused Nasruddin Ansari on 09.04.2017; that her daughter never complained her of any kind of maltreatment or cruelty committed by accused or any of his family members upon her daughter for not bringing dowry; that neither accused nor any of his family members demanded dowry from her, her deceased daughter or her family members; that her daughter never told her that she has been harassed by the accused; that the deceased was living happily with the accused; that the Police officials have obtained her thumb impressions on some papers but she do not what was got written over them as she was illiterate.

RAJINDER (iii) Ms. Samiya (PW-3) deposed that deceased Shaheen KUMAR was her sister, who was married with accused Nasuddin Ansari; that relations between her sister and accused were 16:44:04 +0530 very cordial and there was no dispute between them; that accused never demanded any dowry from her sister or from any of her family members; that two children were born to her sister from Nasruddin.

(iv) Mohd. Arif (PW-4) deposed that deceased Shaheen was his sister; that his brother in law used to keep his sister happily and that he did not demand anything either from deceased sister or from any of their family members; that it was a love marriage between his sister and accused and they both were living happily.

FIR no. 583/2023 State Vs. Nasruddin Ansari (v) Mohd. Asif (PW-5) deposed that deceased Shaheen was his sister; that his brother in law used to keep his sister happily and did not demand anything either from deceased sister or from any of their family members; that it was a love marriage between his sister and accused and they both were living happily.

5. The witnesses were duly cross-examined on behalf of the accused.
ARGUMENTS AND FINDINGS 6. The perusal of record reveals that there are 5 witnesses, all are close relatives of the deceased.
None of them has deposed anything against the accused.
Even, during cross- examination, they in-corrected to all the suggestions put to RAJINDER KUMAR them by the Addl. P.P for the State.
7. Besides the aforesaid 5 close relatives (including mother, brothers and sister of deceased), there is no other material/eye witness to the incident in question in this case.
The role of the other witnesses come into play only after the evidence of the complainant and the other relatives of the deceased.
All the aforesaid witnesses did not support the case of prosecution.
Since, nothing incriminatory has come on record, SA was dispensed with on 03.06.2025.
FIR no. 583/2023 State Vs. Nasruddin Ansari
The evidence led by Sh. Abdul Razak (PW-1), Ajibun Bano (PW-2), Ms. Samiya (PW-3), Mohd. Arif (PW-4) and Mohd. Aasif (PW-5) is not suffice to held the accused guilty for any offence.
For want of sufficient evidence, the charges u/s. 498A/304B IPC could not be proved against the accused.
In view of above, I have no hesitation in holding that the prosecution has failed to prove the charges against the accused.
CONCLUSION 8.
In view of the discussion made herein above, it is held that charges could not be proved against the accused.
For want RAJINDER KUMAR of evidence, the accused is entitled to be acquitted of the charges framed against him.
The accused is held not guilty and consequently, acquitted.
Announced in the open court Date : 04.06.2025.
(Rajinder Kumar) ASJ-05/North-West District Rohini Courts/Delhi/04.06.2025
